lepton.name: lepton
lepton.definition: [l for l in electrons if l['pt'] > 25 and abs(l['eta']) < 2.5] + [l for l in muons if l['pt'] > 20 and abs(l['eta']) < 2.4], met = [o for o in event['objects'] if o['type'] == 6]

jets.name: jets
